about.description: Fidelity Treasury Digital Fund OnChain Class (FYOXX) is the first SEC-registered MMF from Fidelity Investments to record ownership on a public blockchain. Launched 2025 by Fidelity Investments, FYOXX is a share class of the existing Fidelity Treasury Digital Fund and invests in US Treasury securities and repurchase agreements collateralized by Treasuries. Share ownership is recorded on Ethereum via a transfer-agent-controlled smart contract; the on-chain class is institutional-only with a $1M minimum and offered to qualified institutional buyers. Tokens are non-transferable and non-self-custodied; redemptions are in USD via the transfer agent. Fidelity is a top-5 US asset manager and one of the largest US 401(k) administrators; the FYOXX launch follows competitor MMFs from BlackRock (BUIDL), Franklin Templeton (BENJI), and WisdomTree (WTGXX).
about.registryInfo: Fidelity Treasury Digital Fund (FYOXX, OnChain Class) is a series of Fidelity Hereford Street Trust, a Massachusetts business trust registered with the SEC as an open-end investment company under the Investment Company Act of 1940 (CIK 0000877212). Sponsor: Fidelity Investments (FMR LLC, parent), one of the largest US asset managers ($4T+ AUM). The OnChain Class records share ownership on Ethereum via a transfer-agent-controlled smart contract; the underlying assets (US Treasury securities and cash) sit in the master fund. Fund administrator: Fidelity Service Company. Custodian: State Street. Auditor: PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP.

platform.attestationFrequency: Daily NAV; annual audited financials filed with SEC

fees.revenueNotes: Per SEC-filed FYOXX prospectus: gross expense ratio approximately 30 bps; net expense ratio approximately 14 bps after contractual fee waivers. Numbers should be re-verified against the most recent FYOXX prospectus / SAI filing. Tokenization handled in-house by Fidelity transfer agent - no separate vendor fee.
